results.label: the payload the review already reads carries the weekly and quarterly series beside daily and monthly
the buckets are the REVIEW calendar: the Sunday 23:30Z close is in the week that opened on Monday 2026-09-28, and the Friday close is in the next week
and the OTHER ruler is still the journal clock, measured on the same close: the Sunday close is a Lagos MONDAY (daily 2026-10-05, +160) while its review week is 2026-09-28 (+70)
a bucket is that period’s own arithmetic: two closes, one win, one loss, net and R summed, the days counted
the quarterly bucket is the calendar quarter the closes fall in, with the same fields
a close with NO clock is counted by name instead of being silently dropped or guessed into a week
the artifact record rides the same payload, scoped to the analysed account, and is available
a saved week is joined to its own period as `completed`, with its receipt and the trader’s own focus
a draft is a draft and an imported copy is labelled unverified — neither is counted as a completed review
a finished week with no artifact is `not_recorded`, and the record says what that does and does not mean
the OTHER desk’s artifact for the same week is not joined into this account’s record
the quarterly record is the same arithmetic on the quarterly ruler, with the quarter artifact joined
a period with no closed trade reports NO amount rather than a flat zero, and its artifact state is still read
the bucket and the review module’s own financial block agree about the same week — one number, one meaning
reading the review changes NOTHING: every table is byte-identical before and after the two reads
two reads of the same scope are byte-identical, and the series and the artifact record are both in them
the record states what it does NOT do, and never compares reviewed periods against unreviewed ones
the review list the app already served still answers with the same artifacts — this milestone added a reader, not a replacement
the record is scoped to the RESOLVED analysed account, the same account the payload analyses
and a desk that is not the trader’s is refused rather than described: the record answers unknown, never an invented period list
an unreadable artifact table is UNKNOWN on the payload path too, never a period list of "not reviewed"
an empty but readable record is a real record: every period `not_recorded`, no amount invented, and the scope still named
the period the trader asked about is the period reported: the record’s own day is the app’s UTC day, so a period cannot be reported for a clock the caller invented

scope: M13/M65 api: recorded periods and the record of which were reviewed: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
